page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a title block above it and a marginal note at the right of the first lines. Top: a decorative border with no text. Title block, centred: a level-1 heading. Below it: a running text paragraph with a woodcut initial, and at the right margin a section mark "I." beside the first line. Below the last text line, a gathering signature "A" at the right. At the top right, the page number "i".

main_text.l: nij vindiciæ à quibus nostras in-
vir doctus, impugnare, cásque à plano
quodam S. Ignatio subditas esse demon-
strare aggressus est. Verùm ex numerosissi-
gi expendenda, non solùm quia varijs
quoniam ex ijs quæ ab omnibus Pearso-

page.notes: The woodcut initial box shows a stylised monogram resembling "IS"; I read the initial as I, but it is doubtful and is marked [?]. The right-margin mark "I." is a section mark. The decorative border at the top and the digitiser's credit at the bottom right are omitted. The page number "i" is read from the top right and may be a roman numeral "i" or a similar mark. The line ending "Pearso-" continues on the next line as "nij", written here as "Pearso-nij".
